title: Book Two · Chapter 44: Before the Bell
story:
On Tuesday, Ronan finds Jun near the classroom window. Jun has a book open on the desk. His finger rests halfway down the page.

“I need to tell you something,” Ronan says.

Jun keeps his finger in place.

“Yesterday I said there were no problems.”

“With the kite story?”

“Yes. My first answer was wrong. I put the brother at the gate. It was the sister.”

Jun closes his book, but leaves his finger inside.

“Why did you say no problems?”

“I wanted to look clever.”

“You could say two were right.”

“I know. I'm sorry.”

Jun looks at the book in Ronan's hand.

“Can I see your page?”

Ronan opens it. He shows the old word and the new word below it. Jun reads both. Then he gives the page back.

“I was just asking yesterday,” Jun says. “I wasn't laughing at you.”

Ronan nods. He wants Jun to smile now. Jun puts his own book on the desk instead.

“Shall we read this?” Ronan asks.

“I want to finish it myself.”

“All right.”

Jun opens the book again. His finger finds the same place.

Ronan can see a picture of a bus. He wants to ask about it. Jun begins to read the line below the picture, very quietly.

Ronan waits. He nearly points to the word at the end.

Jun moves his own finger there first. Then he turns the page.

“Do you like that one?” Ronan asks.

“I haven't reached the end.”

Ronan looks at the pages still in Jun's right hand.

“It looks funny.”

“It is. I want to find out what the man does.”

Jun goes back to the line. Ronan lets his own book hang beside his leg. Jun was ready to talk yesterday. Today, he wants to finish his book.

He looks toward the window for a moment. Two boys outside are carrying a tray together. Jun does not look up. His page is still open, and he is still reading.

Ronan moves away from the window. Leo is sorting pencils at their desk. There is room beside him, and Ronan sits down.

For a while, Jun's chair makes no sound. Ronan looks back once. Jun is still reading.

The bell goes. Miss Wu asks the class to open their school books. Ronan finds his place. He points to the first line with his pencil.

He does not speak to Jun during the lesson. At break, he gets the ball from Leo's bag. Jun is already at the door with another child.

“Are you coming?” Ronan asks.

“In a moment.”

Jun finishes his talk first. Ronan waits by the wall.

Outside, Leo draws a small circle with his heel. He throws the ball to Jun. Jun sends it to the other child. Ronan waits one more turn.

Then the ball comes to him. He catches it with both hands. Jun lifts his hands for the return.

Ronan throws it gently. The ball reaches Jun's chest. Jun catches it and steps back.

“Farther now,” he says.

They keep playing. Jun does not mention the story. Ronan does not ask again for a smile.

After break, Miss Wu points to the job list. Tomorrow Mei will keep the cards with another child. Ronan will put books in order.

“Do we all use the pencil?” he asks.

“One person writes at a time,” Miss Wu says. “Talk to each other first.”

Mei takes a scrap and writes her own turn on it. Ronan looks at the shelf. Some books lean sideways. One small book is almost flat under a taller one.

He moves the tall book a little. The small one stands up again.

Jun passes the desk on the way to his seat. His pencil drops from the open book. Ronan points to it near the table leg.

Jun picks up his pencil.

“Thanks,” he says.

Ronan puts his hand back on the shelf. He leaves the book cards on Miss Wu's desk.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

clever＝聪明的；sorry＝抱歉；wrong＝错的；turn＝轮到的一次。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样向Jun更正昨天的话？
2. Jun的反应为什么不能算作立刻全部和好？

## 读句子

**Jun / picks up / his pencil.** Jun／捡起／他的铅笔。
